frozen_design.decision: First require actual execution differences. One fixed cap is provisionally sufficient for the primary objective if its fulljointgoodput improves>=3% in both reversedpairs, allrequestscomplete, rawthroughputdoesnotdecrease, and TTFT/flow/maxgap p95 do not worsen>5%, with noadded100msgapfailures. Otherwise report the completefixedfrontier and whether tradeoff signs repeat; noisy/mixed signs are inconclusive. Only a reproducible tradeoff plus observable state variation warrants count/closest-dynamic comparisons and a new signal. No controller or intermediate-cap grid; same gates retained. All qualification changes reported.
frozen_design.interpretation: One additional load point only, samefrozen1024/2048/2048/1024 andwarmboth,4formalmax. No new controller, cap tuning, load grid or automatic repeats. Fixedcapthroughput/qualificationtradeoff remains descriptive until real state-selective intervention. If fixedcaps still suffice, close this three-point operating range; if broad overload/no usefulaction tradeoff, do not keep increasingload. If qualification sets exchange reproducibly, first locate legal current-state opportunities before selector development. An observation failure from existing nativeguards is preserved, not a negativeperformance outcome.
frozen_design.execution: Unmodified parent run_confirmation.py/launch.sh; cap-only native patch. Existing no-preempt/all-decoder-service checks remain; any failure is a preserved observation failure, not a negative performance result.
